method.order: ABBA in fresh renderers per scenario. Tests and diagnostic profiles completed before accepted timings.
method.cold: 37 active packages. Immediate typing or 500 ms idle; 3 openings per process. Popup readiness checks visibility attributes and then waits two animation frames. Boolean editor identity assertion avoids diagnostic object formatting.
method.refresh: 43 active packages with real SOFiSTiK LSP, Outline closed. 60 Enter edits then 180 wheel events at 60 Hz. Two consumers request symbols 50 ms after typing, before the 300 ms stop-changing debounce. A 10 second provider timeout permits complete 195778-symbol responses in both variants.
method.markers: 38 active packages and a deterministic provider through the real service. 20k materialized markers, or 100k indexed tokens with 415 viewport markers. Work time awaits fetch; presentation time includes two subsequent animation frames.
method.limits: Fresh modules, not cold OS caches. Two processes per variant/condition; ranges are descriptive, not population-tail estimates. Windows process CPU measurements are coarse. Cold cases do not activate semantic-tokens; their active package sources match final code. No worker migration or server protocol change.
